```{r}
#| label: load-and-generate
#| include: false

# Per aggiungere una presentazione: copia il file nella repo e aggiungi una riga
# in allSlides.csv (vedi README.md). Link puo' essere un URL completo oppure il
# solo percorso del file nella repo (es. "Toffalini-Troina-2026.pdf").

library(qrcode)
library(htmltools)

base_url = "https://enricotoffalini.github.io/slides/"
mesi = c("gen","feb","mar","apr","mag","giu","lug","ago","set","ott","nov","dic")

# lettura robusta del CSV: UTF-8 (anche con BOM) oppure Windows-1252 (Excel);
# separatore "," oppure ";" (Excel in italiano)
raw = readBin("allSlides.csv", "raw", file.size("allSlides.csv"))
if (length(raw) >= 3 && all(raw[1:3] == as.raw(c(0xEF, 0xBB, 0xBF)))) raw = raw[-(1:3)]
txt = rawToChar(raw)
if (!validUTF8(txt)) txt = iconv(txt, from = "CP1252", to = "UTF-8")
Encoding(txt) = "UTF-8"
header = strsplit(txt, "\r?\n")[[1]][1]
sep = ifelse(grepl(";", header) & !grepl(",", header), ";", ",")
slides = read.csv(text = txt, sep = sep, colClasses = "character", strip.white = TRUE, encoding = "UTF-8")
slides = slides[!is.na(slides$Title) & slides$Title != "" & !is.na(slides$Link) & slides$Link != "", ]

# link relativi -> URL completo
isRel = !grepl("^https?://", slides$Link)
slides$Link[isRel] = paste0(base_url, sub("^/+", "", slides$Link[isRel]))

# controllo che i file locali esistano (match esatto, maiuscole comprese come su GitHub Pages)
isLocal = startsWith(slides$Link, base_url)
localPath = unname(sapply(sub(base_url, "", slides$Link, fixed = TRUE), URLdecode))
notFound = isLocal & !(localPath %in% list.files(".", recursive = TRUE))
if (any(notFound)) message("ATTENZIONE, file non trovati nella repo:\n  ", paste(localPath[notFound], collapse = "\n  "))
slides$QR_File = file.path("qr", paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "", ifelse(isLocal, localPath, slides$Link)), ".svg"))

# date: "2024", "2025-02", "2026-01_15" oppure "2026-01-15"
dparts = strsplit(gsub("_", "-", slides$Year), "-")
slides$yy = as.integer(sapply(dparts, `[`, 1))
slides$mm = as.integer(sapply(dparts, `[`, 2))
slides$dd = as.integer(sapply(dparts, `[`, 3))
badDate = is.na(slides$yy) | (!is.na(slides$mm) & !slides$mm %in% 1:12)
if (any(badDate)) message("ATTENZIONE, date non riconosciute: ", paste(slides$Year[badDate], collapse = ", "))
slides$mm[badDate] = NA
slides$dateLabel = ifelse(!is.na(slides$dd), paste(slides$dd, mesi[slides$mm]),
                   ifelse(!is.na(slides$mm), mesi[slides$mm], ""))
sortKey = ifelse(is.na(slides$yy), 0, slides$yy) * 1e4 +
  ifelse(is.na(slides$mm), 0, slides$mm) * 100 + ifelse(is.na(slides$dd), 0, slides$dd)
slides = slides[order(-sortKey), ]

# formato (PDF / HTML)
ext = tolower(tools::file_ext(sub("[?#].*$", "", slides$Link)))
slides$Format = ifelse(ext == "pdf", "PDF", ifelse(ext %in% c("html", "htm"), "HTML", "Link"))

# QR code come SVG compatti in qr/, nome derivato dal link (rigenerati a ogni render,
# quindi sempre aggiornati; i file obsoleti in qr/ vengono rimossi)
qr_svg = function(url, file, quiet = 1) {  # qr_code() include gia' 3 moduli di margine
  m = unclass(qr_code(url, ecl = "L"))
  n = nrow(m)
  d = character(0)
  for (y in seq_len(n)) {
    r = rle(as.logical(m[y, ]))
    x0 = cumsum(r$lengths) - r$lengths
    k = which(r$values)
    d = c(d, sprintf("M%d %dh%dv1h-%dz", x0[k] + quiet, y - 1 + quiet, r$lengths[k], r$lengths[k]))
  }
  s = n + 2 * quiet
  cat(sprintf('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 %d %d" shape-rendering="crispEdges"><rect width="%d" height="%d" fill="#fff"/><path fill="#1d1d1b" d="%s"/></svg>',
              s, s, s, s, paste(d, collapse = "")), file = file)
}
qr_dir = "qr"
if (!dir.exists(qr_dir)) dir.create(qr_dir)
for (i in seq_len(nrow(slides))) qr_svg(slides$Link[i], slides$QR_File[i])
obsolete = setdiff(list.files(qr_dir, full.names = TRUE), slides$QR_File)
if (length(obsolete) > 0) file.remove(obsolete)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

esc = function(x) htmlEscape(x, attribute = TRUE)
years = unique(slides$yy)
yrange = range(slides$yy, na.rm = TRUE)

cat('```{=html}\n')
cat(sprintf('
<header class="hero">
  <div class="wrap">
    <p class="eyebrow"><a href="https://enricotoffalini.github.io" target="_blank">Enrico Toffalini</a></p>
    <h1>Deposito slide <span lang="en">Slide repository</span></h1>
    <p class="lead">Questa pagina raccoglie principalmente le mie slide per convegni e seminari. Per il materiale didattico vedi <a href="https://enricotoffalini.github.io/Courses.html" target="_blank">enricotoffalini.github.io/Courses.html</a>.</p>
    <p class="lead lead-en" lang="en">This page mainly collects my slides for conferences and seminars. For open teaching materials please visit <a href="https://enricotoffalini.github.io/Courses.html" target="_blank">enricotoffalini.github.io/Courses.html</a>.</p>
    <p class="stats"><span>%d presentazioni</span><span>%d&ndash;%d</span></p>
  </div>
</header>
<div class="toolbar">
  <div class="wrap">
    <label class="search">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="m20 20-3.5-3.5"/></svg>
      <input type="search" id="q" placeholder="Cerca / Search" autocomplete="off" aria-label="Cerca">
    </label>
    <span class="count" id="count" aria-live="polite"></span>
  </div>
</div>
<main class="wrap" id="list">
', nrow(slides), yrange[1], yrange[2]))

for (y in years) {
  s = slides[slides$yy %in% y, ]
  cat(sprintf('<section class="year"><h2 class="year-label">%s</h2><ol class="talks">\n', ifelse(is.na(y), "&ndash;", y)))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(s))) {
    cat(sprintf('<li class="talk" data-search="%s">
  <div class="talk-body">
    <p class="talk-meta">%s<span class="event">%s</span></p>
    <h3 class="talk-title"><a href="%s" target="_blank">%s</a></h3>
    <a class="btn" href="%s" target="_blank">Slide %s<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7 17 17 7M8 7h9v9"/></svg></a>
  </div>
  <button class="qr" type="button" data-qr="%s" data-title="%s" aria-label="Mostra QR code ingrandito"><img src="%s" alt="QR code" width="84" height="84" loading="lazy"></button>
</li>\n',
      esc(tolower(paste(s$Title[i], s$Congress[i], s$Year[i]))),
      ifelse(s$dateLabel[i] == "", "", sprintf('<time>%s</time>', s$dateLabel[i])),
      htmlEscape(s$Congress[i]),
      esc(s$Link[i]), htmlEscape(s$Title[i]),
      esc(s$Link[i]), s$Format[i],
      s$QR_File[i], esc(s$Title[i]), s$QR_File[i]))
  }
  cat('</ol></section>\n')
}

cat(sprintf('
<p class="empty" id="empty" hidden>Nessun risultato / No results</p>
</main>
<footer class="site-footer">
  <div class="wrap">
    <p><a href="https://enricotoffalini.github.io" target="_blank">Enrico Toffalini</a></p>
    <p>Aggiornato il %s</p>
  </div>
</footer>
<dialog id="qr-dialog">
  <div class="qr-box">
    <img src="" alt="QR code">
    <p class="qr-title"></p>
    <button type="button" class="qr-close" aria-label="Chiudi">&times;</button>
  </div>
</dialog>
', format(Sys.Date(), "%d/%m/%Y")))
cat('\n```\n')
```

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  var norm = function (s) { return s.normalize("NFD").replace(/[̀-ͯ]/g, "").toLowerCase(); };
  var q = document.getElementById("q"), count = document.getElementById("count"), empty = document.getElementById("empty");
  var talks = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".talk"));
  talks.forEach(function (t) { t._s = norm(t.getAttribute("data-search")); });
  function update() {
    var words = norm(q.value.trim()).split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean), n = 0;
    talks.forEach(function (t) {
      var ok = words.every(function (w) { return t._s.indexOf(w) !== -1; });
      t.hidden = !ok; if (ok) n++;
    });
    document.querySelectorAll(".year").forEach(function (y) { y.hidden = !y.querySelector(".talk:not([hidden])"); });
    count.textContent = words.length ? n + " / " + talks.length : "";
    empty.hidden = n > 0;
  }
  q.addEventListener("input", update);
  var dlg = document.getElementById("qr-dialog");
  if (dlg && dlg.showModal) {
    document.querySelectorAll(".qr").forEach(function (b) {
      b.addEventListener("click", function () {
        dlg.querySelector("img").src = b.getAttribute("data-qr");
        dlg.querySelector(".qr-title").textContent = b.getAttribute("data-title");
        dlg.showModal();
      });
    });
    dlg.querySelector(".qr-close").addEventListener("click", function () { dlg.close(); });
    dlg.addEventListener("click", function (e) { if (e.target === dlg) dlg.close(); });
  }
})();
</script>
```
